_comment: Named events (festivals, fairs, expos, cons, biennials, art walks, open studios, weeks) that rows in our configured feeds mention and the map does not carry. Written by catalog_mentions.py from the feeds-* artifacts of aggregate-events.yml, daily in curate-catalog.yml. A pending mention is a lead for a human: an organiser's own prose-only site goes in annual_sources.json, a feed in the ordinary catalog. Set state to "declined" (with a reason in _not_included if it should never come back) to stop seeing one. URLs only; never copy a contact address in here.
